en.headline: Mid-Autumn lantern carnival returns to Victoria Park on 17 September
en.dek: LCSD’s Bing-wu lantern carnival runs free of charge from 17 to 27 September, alongside the Tourism Board’s first international lantern showcase at the same park.
body: The Leisure and Cultural Services Department will stage the Bing-wu year Mid-Autumn Lantern Carnival at Victoria Park from 17 to 27 September, the Community Programmes Office said. A separate Mid-Autumn light installation will run at the Hong Kong Cultural Centre piazza from 17 September to 11 October.

Lanterns will be lit from 6.30pm to 11pm. Lighting on Mid-Autumn night, 25 September, will be extended to midnight. Admission is free. The department said the carnival forms part of the Chinese Culture Festival. Entry to Victoria Park will be first come, first served, and organisers may pause admission to manage crowds; the public was advised to follow instructions from staff and police, and to consider visiting on nights other than Mid-Autumn Day.

The Hong Kong Tourism Board will hold its first International Mid-Autumn Lantern Showcase at the same park over the same dates, RTHK reported when the programme was announced. The Board said the display would bring lanterns from 20 countries and regions and four large Nanjing Qinhuai lantern groups, including an eight-metre work inspired by a Hong Kong banyan tree at the park entrance. Open flames, alcoholic drinks, metal balloons and glass bottles are barred from the carnival grounds.

zh.headline: 丙午年中秋綵燈會下週四維園亮燈
zh.dek: 康文署綵燈會9月17日至27日於維園免費開放，旅發局同期首辦國際中秋綵燈匯，文化中心露天廣場另設光影裝置至10月11日。
body: 康樂及文化事務署社區節目辦事處公布，丙午年中秋綵燈會將於9月17日至27日在維多利亞公園舉行。香港文化中心露天廣場則由9月17日至10月11日設置中秋光影裝置。
綵燈亮燈時間為晚上6時30分至11時，中秋節正日9月25日延長至午夜12時，免費入場。當局指活動屬中華文化節節目之一。維園以先到先得方式入場，大會可按情況暫停放人；參觀人士須聽從現場職員及警方指示，並盡量選擇正日以外晚上前往，以免過於擠迫。
港台早前引述香港旅遊發展局，局方將於相同日期在維園首辦「國際中秋綵燈匯」，展出來自20個國家及地區的綵燈，以及四組南京秦淮巨型燈組，包括正門一組高約八米、以本港大榔樹為靈感的作品。綵燈會場地禁止攜帶明火燈籠、酒精類飲品、金屬氣球及玻璃瓶。
